newsitem.title: USA: Geneva Steel sees car shortage hurting Q4.
newsitem.headline: Geneva Steel sees car shortage hurting Q4.

text.p: Geneva Steel Co said Thursday it saw a shortage of rail cars as well as production disruptions "negatively" affecting its fourth-quarter earnings.
The company said in a statement that the problems had also affected its third quarter earnings, without elaborating.
Geneva nevertheless reported a profit of $0.08 per share for the third quarter, compared to a loss of $0.43 for the same period last year.
The figure beat the forecast set by First Call's consensus among analysts at a loss of $0.03 per share.
A company official told Reuters the improved figure was due to an $875,000 tax benefit for utilization of a net operating carry forward, as well as improved operations.
First Call forecasts a loss of $0.03 per share for the fourth quarter.
Geneva said in the statement production disruptions were due to a mill modernization project.
